description.value: Carnitas Don Jose is a Mexican food-court stall in downtown Vancouver run by Don José Velázquez, an 8-time Mexican charrería national champion turned chef who brings traditional Carnitas Estilo Michoacán from Zamora, Michoacán to the city. The menu centres on slow-cooked carnitas served with corn tortillas, salsas, and fresh accompaniments, made with locally sourced ingredients. With over 1,500 Uber Eats reviews at 4.7 stars, it has earned a devoted following as a quick, affordable stop for authentic Mexican street food in the heart of Vancouver.
